agent_messages: Use the Laurent parametrization \(x=(z+z^{-1})/2\): \(T_n(x)\) is the symmetric part of \(z^n\), so composition becomes multiplication of exponents. The remaining facts follow from the second-order Chebyshev recurrence, whose determinant-one transfer matrix preserves a Cassini-type quadratic invariant and controls both negative indices and low-degree values.
